jobs.description:
Job ID
26WD101528
**Job Requisition ID \#**


26WD101528
**Position Overview**
  

Autodesk is transforming how the AEC industry designs and builds through integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) across its products, including AutoCAD, Revit, and Forma.
  

  

As Head of Engineering, ML for Forma Generative AI, you will lead the ML Engineering organization responsible for computational design and data representations, applied ML model development, and ML infrastructure and operations. You will lead through three engineering managers, setting the ML strategy for the team, defining the technical and organizational standards across the discipline, and shaping how teams build, deploy, and operate production ML systems.
  

  

You will partner closely with Architecture, Software Engineering, Research, Product, and other senior leaders to define technical direction, resolve cross\-organizational trade\-offs, and ensure the organization can move from promising ML research to reliable product capabilities at scale.
  

  

**Report:** You will report to the Director, Forma Generative AI.
  

  

**Location:** We support hybrid work, and you work near our Toronto, Canada office. This role requires the ability to travel to team meetings, offsites, and conferences in the USA, Canada, and Europe.
  

  

**Responsibilities**

  

  

* Define and uphold ML engineering strategy, standards, and expectations across the organization, including how ML systems are designed, tested, reviewed, deployed, evaluated, and operated in production
* Lead and develop the engineering managers responsible for Computational Design \& Data Representations, Applied ML, and ML Infrastructure and Operations. Own the evolution of the ML engineering organization, including team structure, boundaries, hiring, succession, and organizational design
* Partner with Architecture and peer engineering leaders to establish shared ML architectures, reusable components, and engineering practices that enable teams to move quickly without compromising quality or consistency
* Partner with Research, Product, and Engineering leaders to balance long\-term ML research and platform investments with iterative product delivery; align priorities, staffing, and capacity across the ML organization; surface constraints early and resolve cross\-team trade\-offs to keep critical work moving
* Represent ML engineering in organizational planning, resourcing, escalations, and major technical decisions, serving as the discipline’s leadership voice across Forma Generative AI
* Build a high\-trust engineering culture that develops strong technical leaders, encourages knowledge sharing, and raises the quality of engineering judgement across the organization
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

  

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 8\+ years of software/ML engineering experience, including 4\+ years of engineering management experience and demonstrated experience managing engineering managers or leading multiple engineering teams
* Track record building and operating production ML systems at scale across training, deployment, inference, monitoring, and evaluation
* Experience establishing engineering standards and technical direction across multiple teams without centralizing every decision
* Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers and senior technical leads, with strong communication and influence across senior stakeholders
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

  

* Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for large\-scale ML or foundation\-model systems
* Deep technical familiarity with modern ML engineering and production infrastructure, including ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), distributed training and inference, cloud infrastructure, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and production automation
* Experience designing or leading development of foundation\-model and agentic systems, including evaluation harnesses, tool\-use/orchestration patterns, and other production scaffolding around models
* Experience partnering with peer engineering, architecture, research, and product leaders in a matrixed organization
* Experience in the AEC industry, Autodesk products, or another technically complex design/engineering domain
* Experience applying rapidly evolving foundation\-model and agentic\-system technologies in production environments
  

  

**The Ideal Candidate**

  

  

* You know the difference between managing a team and leading an organization; you develop strong managers, create clear ownership, and scale through others
* You can establish a technical bar and make it stick through standards, coaching, and strong engineering judgement rather than personal gatekeeping
* You build trust with senior peers across architecture, research, product, and engineering, and can navigate disagreement and ambiguity while keeping the organization moving
* You communicate effectively across disciplines and levels, adapting your approach to build shared understanding with technical, product, research, and executive audiences

**Learn More**


**About Autodesk**


Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

jobs.description:
**Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.**


The Director of Application Development will lead the design, development, and delivery of some of our most critical customer digital applications and all our in\-house cargo applications. Its customer application portfolio consists of aircanada.com’s content related applications (Content Management System (CMS) platform, Homepage), marketing digital assets (Offer Management, DNA) as well as Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM). Its cargo portfolio includes the cargo website (informational and transactional), the cargo distribution API, the cargo digital backend and all the cargo integrations, a portfolio that keeps growing with the new Cargo Management System implementation through the end of 2028\.


This role will also be responsible for the Delivery COE and the Innovation COE for all the customer and cargo portfolios. The Delivery COE aims at harmonizing the delivery practice, KPIs, continuous improvements within the portfolio. The Innovation COE aims at improving our digital technology platforms, through continuous improvements (i.e., progressive AI adoption, Continuous Integration /Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipeline enhancements, etc) as well as disruptive innovations through POCs and partnership with Air Canada’s key technology vendors (i.e., transition to Mono Repo, introduction of a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) stack, etc.). This role is key to our digital transformation journey and will be pivotal in empowering the IDD organization to achieve its cost transformation and innovation goals.


This role will also focus on people leadership, including talent acquisition, training, performance management, and fostering a high\-performing team culture.

**Responsibilities:**

* Leadership \& Strategy
	+ Provide strategic and hands\-on leadership for teams building the future marketing and content technology landscape for Air Canada
	+ Lead the cargo deliver teams towards a successful implementation of the new Cargo Management System.
	+ Deliver disruptive technology driven innovations that dramatically increase revenue or reduce cost.
	+ Drive the insourcing strategy by recruiting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent, reducing reliance on vendor\-driven delivery models.
	+ Collaborate with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, and Architects to define the product vision, architecture, and development roadmap.
* Technology \& Innovation
	+ Oversee the delivery of robust, scalable, and secure digital applications, with a focus on performance, user experience, and maintainability.
	+ Ensure modern engineering practices are followed, including Agile delivery, CI/CD automation, DevSecOps, test automation, and shift\-left testing.
	+ Champion the use and integration of Generative AI tooling and AI Agents within the development lifecycle to increase developer productivity and enable rapid iteration.
	+ Stay ahead of emerging technologies and assess their relevance and value for digital product development.
	+ Foster a culture of engineering excellence through code quality, design standards, peer reviews, and continuous learning.
* Execution \& Delivery
	+ Own end\-to\-end product delivery, from development through production deployment and support.
	+ Collaborate closely with internal product managers, designers, architects, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely and high\-quality product releases.
	+ Monitor team performance, manage risks, remove delivery blockers, and drive accountability for outcomes.
	+ Ensure proper technical documentation and knowledge\-sharing across teams.
* Collaboration \& Communication
	+ Partner cross\-functionally with other IT and Digital leaders, including Architecture, Security, Data, and Infrastructure teams.
	+ Engage with key business stakeholders across Digital, Marketing, Loyalty, and HR to ensure alignment between product features and business priorities.
	+ Present technical strategies and delivery progress to senior leadership, contributing to enterprise\-wide technology planning.
* People \& Budget Management
	+ Manage operational and capital budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation and delivery within financial targets.
	+ Develop and maintain staffing plans, forecast resource needs, and align capacity to strategic priorities.
	+ Support training and professional development programs to grow technical capabilities within the team.
	+ Establish performance metrics and continuous improvement practices for team delivery and application performance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* 10\+ years of experience in digital application development, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing front\-end and back\-end development teams.
* Proven success in leading digital transformations, including insourcing and adoption of modern development frameworks and practices.
* Deep technical expertise in web and mobile application development, microservices, cloud\-native architecture, and API ecosystems.
* Experience integrating AI/ML technologies or Generative AI into product development lifecycles is a strong asset.
* Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD best practices.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across both business and technology teams.
* Experience working in or with enterprise\-scale organizations, ideally in travel, transportation, or customer experience\-driven industries.
* Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast\-paced environment.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Pension Data Operations & Governance
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY BACKGROUND \& CULTURE
  
UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector\-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.
  
We’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast\-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.
  
We’ve built and nurtured a culture that is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI\&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace. As UPP celebrates its fifth anniversary, we’re proud to be recognized for our efforts:
  
* 2026 Greater Toronto’s Top 100 Employers
* 2026 Canadian HR Award for Excellence in Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging


Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional individual to join a team of high performing professionals and make a significant impact.
  
As UPP builds its engagement model and implements a new Pension Administration Solution, the Associate Director, Pension Operations will play a dedicated role in engaging with the project team to build the go forward member and employer service experience and build out training strategy and artifacts. Once the project is complete, they will then transition to lead the teams accountable for service delivery.
  
Reporting to the Managing Director, Service Experience will build strong trusted relationships and communicate effectively with UPP’s members and employers in the support and development of UPP’s Pension services. This role will lead three lines of business: Member Transactions, pension payroll and Data, Reporting and Analytics. The role will provide leadership for pension data operations and governance, ensuring pension data is treated as a strategic asset with clear ownership, defined quality standards, effective controls, and transparent reporting across member, employer, payroll, actuarial, finance, technology, and regulatory processes.
  
In support of the Managing Director, Service Experience, this position will have a role in helping UPP meet our own strategic imperative to deliver world\-class services to our members and employers.
  
This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in\-office (approximately two days per week in\-office).
  
This job is for an existing vacancy.
  
SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES
  
Pension Data Governance Leadership
  
* Establish and operationalize a pension data governance framework with clear accountabilities, data standards, data definitions, business rules, lineage, and critical data elements required to support accurate member records, contributions, service, earnings, calculations, payroll, reporting, and regulatory obligations.
* Lead pension data quality management across key dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, reliability, relevance, access, coherence, and interpretability, with measurable thresholds, monitoring routines, issue management, and escalation protocols.
* Build and oversee data controls for inbound employer data, member events, pension calculations, payroll interfaces, system conversions, reconciliations, reporting extracts, and downstream data uses.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and remediation of pension data issues, ensuring defects are prioritized based on member impact, financial risk, regulatory exposure, operational risk, and employer experience.
* Develop governance routines, dashboards, and reporting that provide senior leadership and Board\-level visibility into data quality, data risks, remediation progress, unresolved exceptions, and emerging trends.
* Partner with Pension Operations, Employer Experience, Member Experience, Technology, Finance, Actuarial, Legal, Privacy, and Risk teams to ensure data governance practices support plan administration, member outcomes, compliance, and service excellence.
* Champion a culture of data accountability by creating practical guidance, training, issue resolution routines, and continuous improvement practices that strengthen trust in pension data across the organization.
* Act as a subject\-matter expert of UPP plan provisions and calculation rules
* Instill a service mindset in team members
* Develop an expert internal team to build UPP’s member service offering and intellectual capital base
* Exhibit an ability to listen, negotiate and communicate goals; share knowledge, experience, and responsibility with the team to achieve the highest standards of professionalism
* Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector
* Other projects and activities, as required


QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or other related disciplines
* Possessing an MBA, C EBS, PPAC or any other relevant professional designation would be an asset
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in pensions

* Demonstrated success working in a hands\-on multi\-faceted stakeholder environment

**What is the opportunity?**

  

As Director, Corporate Client Group Finance (CCGF), you are part of the mid\-market Corporate Banking team and play a key role in the realization of Corporate Client Group (CCG) objectives through the structuring, delivery and management of the bank debt of a targeted customer base. We target loan origination in the Canadian mid\-market, including large Canadian subsidiaries of foreign multinationals, private and small cap public Canadian companies, and are responsible for meeting annually established targets for loan derived revenues and returns by providing advice to our partners on optimizing the use of lending in connection with broader RBC relationship goals.

 **What will you do?**

* Support CCG relationship managers to structure, deliver, close, and monitor loan transactions under direction of the Senior Director CCG Finance, including credit submissions and transaction presentations
* Support CCG relationship managers in the preparation and presentation of marketing pitches to existing and potential clients
* Follow up and engage with RBC partners and functions including Group Risk Management, Private Banking, RBC Investments, Capital Markets, specialized teams in Commercial Financial Services (leasing, trade finance etc.), Personal Banking, and others
* Work with Group Risk Management to ensure proper alignment with credit processes and client expectations Provide research, analysis, and data (market, industry, client, and competitor) to support CCG advice on the optimal amount of bank debt required to meet strategic objectives with each client relationship

**Location:** Martin Luther University College, Waterloo, Ontario

**Reports to:** Principal\-Dean

**Direct Reports:** 1 \- 2 roles

**Salary:** $90,000 \- $120,000 annually

**Start date**: December 2026

**This is an existing vacancy.**

**Position Summary**

Martin Luther University College (Luther) is a public university college federated with Wilfrid Laurier University. We are a faith\-based academic community committed to excellence in teaching, research, and community engagement.

The Director of Finance and Administration provides strategic and operational leadership for Luther’s financial and administrative functions. Reporting to the Principal\-Dean, the Director is responsible for financial reporting, compliance, planning and budgeting, internal controls, and administrative systems that support the long\-term financial sustainability of the institution and its mission.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership of Financial Planning, Management, and Reporting**

* Ensure all necessary financial operations (including the operating budget), reporting, cash management, expenditure controls and other controls are in place and operating effectively to support Luther’s operations and the Board’s fiduciary obligations.
* Prepare financial analysis and reports as needed including operating statements (revenues and expenditures), budget forecasts, and forecast of cash flow for use by the Principal\-Dean, responsible managers or faculty, and the Finance Committee to support informed decision\-making and organizational accountability for a $4 Million operating budget.
* Manage the allocation of annual realized gains from endowment funds and reconcile investment manager’s reports for endowed and non\-endowed investments, resolving discrepancies.
* Take the initiative to manage investment transactions required as part of the annual budget or operations. Coordinate the flow of investment deposits and investment income with investment manager. Liaise with Luther’s investment manager and/or Finance Committee on investment issues for accounting purposes.

* Assist Luther’s staff and faculty in understanding and using relevant financial information. Support them in budget development for their areas or projects.
* Understand in detail and make recommendations to enhance the funding agreements between Luther and Wilfrid Laurier University and be able to advise the Principal\-Dean on the implications to annual revenue of proposed revisions to these agreements.
* Maximize the use of accounting software reporting capabilities where possible.
* Manage the financial elements of grant projects, supporting the assigned project manager in planning and tracking financial commitments, and in financial reporting for the project.
* Prepare and submit annual financial and statistical reporting required by external organizations such as Canada Revenue Agency (Registered Charity Information Return \-\- T3010, HST), Council of Ontario Universities (detailed analytical financial report), Association of Theological Schools, and others as required. * Develop the annual capital budget (including equipment) for Board approval to maintain the Luther’s physical assets and avoid undue deferred maintenance.
* Oversee the implementation of the capital budget.
* Manage the financial elements of capital and construction projects.
* Manage the financial elements of capital and construction projects.

* Act as the Chief Compliance Officer for reporting and legal requirements.

**Policy Coordination and Board Support**

* Coordinate policy needs and improvements with the Principal\-Dean to ensure all operational and board policies are consistently organized, reviewed, updated, and in compliance.

**Support to the Principal\-Dean**

* Support the activities of the Principal\-Dean through research, high\-level project/program development and implementation, implementation of confidential activities and other areas as they arise from time to time.

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
